title: Local IPC error code
description: Local errors are deliberately MORE precise than the remote wire. A remote peer never receives EndpointUnknown, EndpointDisabled, or EndpointClientKindDenied — those collapse to the coarse `no_route` class so the directed protocol cannot become an endpoint-existence oracle (ADR-0030). Keeping both vocabularies in one repository makes the asymmetry reviewable rather than accidental.
